sentences.en: In order to do that, you have to take risks.
sentences.zh: 为了做到这一点，你必须承担风险。

sentences.en: All you have to do is to obey my orders.
sentences.zh: 你要做的就是听从我的命令。

sentences.en: I will sell the boat in accordance with your orders.
sentences.zh: 我会按照你的指示卖掉这条船。

collocations.zh: 无次序的；有毛病的，出故障的
